verdict.rationale: Cursor documents API-key authentication as an alternative to the interactive browser login. The CLI takes a CURSOR_API_KEY for scripts and CI, the Cloud Agents API and SDK accept user or service-account API keys, and a live probe confirms the API is gated by API key. Bring-your-own model-provider keys are a separate capability and are not credited here. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of the CLI key flow; service-account keys are Enterprise-only, so non-human credentials are not available on every plan.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login

citations.quote: Set API key for scripts: export CURSOR_API_KEY=your_api_key_here; agent -p 'Analyze this code'

Service accounts can authenticate the Cursor CLI by setting the API key as CURSOR_API_KEY. This is the recommended way to run the CLI in CI/CD pipelines, cron jobs, and other non-interactive environments.
a user API key from Cursor Dashboard → API Keys, or a service account API key
